label: water-master of
notes: Sixty-one, thirty-one crossings, not one traveller lost to thirst, and she says the ration figure aloud each dawn before anyone asks. Her authority over water is the one 'no' Ysoly has to answer, which makes her the hinge of any argument about a forced run. A sea under the plain is not deliverance to her - it is the end of the only expertise she has, so she is the hand most likely to want the survey to be wrong.
